_doc: Karmi Laven online prices + shipping: the ONE table the server charges from (api/_pricing.js) and /api/stock serves as `ladders`. Mode cart_qty_groups (M1, Mert's list 23 Nov 2026, K-046): every product belongs to a group with an ONLINE single price and a 10+ price; with 10+ units in the cart (all groups counted together) every unit pays its group's 10+ price; 1-9 units pay the single price (no intermediate steps, no cap). Gradient Edit = group B (8.00, 10+ 2.40). Delivery 1.49, free with 10+ units (no spend threshold). Non-Gradient products need DB karmi_online_products.online_group (else family_groups). Previous table: tests/fixtures/ladders.live-2026-11-23.json. See docs/LADDERS.md, docs/GO_LIVE_M1.md.
